name: Aquila
categories: FMCG dry, beverages, coffee, snacks, non-food, pet
column9: BVB-listed (AQ); largest RO independent FMCG distributor; own logistics arm. Competitor risk LOW (no producer offtake conflict for our RO core).

name: Macromex
categories: frozen + chilled: fish/seafood (Edenia), ice cream, frozen veg/fruit, meat
column9: Market leader frozen/chilled RO; owns Edenia/La Strada brands. BEST route for fish/seafood + frozen long-tail.

name: Interbrands Orbico
categories: branded FMCG, coffee, confectionery, personal care, household, beverages
column9: Orbico group (largest CEE distributor) absorbed Interbrands. Strong branded portfolio incl. coffee/cocoa/household.

name: Whiteland
column9: Large RO distributor; broad dry-grocery + non-food coverage.

name: Parmafood
categories: deli, cheese, charcuterie, olive oil, Italian/Mediterranean specialty, olives
column9: Specialist in Italian/Mediterranean deli + olive oil + olives. BEST route for olive oil/olives/pasta specialty.

name: TGIE (Transilvania General Import Export)
categories: groceries, canned, dry goods, beverages, some HoReCa
column9: Importer + distributor; pasta/rice/canned/dry exotic goods. Good for dry exotic long-tail.

name: Metro Cash & Carry
categories: full-range: produce incl. citrus/tropical/banana, fish/seafood counter, coffee, dry goods, olive oil, non-food
terms: cash/card or Metro credit account (~14-30d for registered biz)
column9: PRIMARY launch route for single pilot. Low volume, no MOQ, immediate. Weakest margin (retail-minus-pro markup). HoReCa account needed.

name: Selgros
categories: full-range incl. citrus/tropical, fish counter, coffee, dry/exotic, non-food, household
column9: Secondary cash&carry; price-compare vs Metro per category. Good backup + non-food/household top-up.

name: Direct import (own)
column9: NOT viable for 1 pilot. Becomes viable at ~5-8 stores / pallet-week volume per category. Best margin but needs customs + ANSVSA import authorization + working capital.
